completion_data.completion_summary: Added hard-mode routing to the lean4 extension: created lean-research-hard-agent and lean-implementation-hard-agent (both model: opus), lean4 contract overrides for H2 and H3, skill-lean-research-hard and skill-lean-implementation-hard, and updated manifest.json with routing_hard, index-entries.json with 2 new contract entries, and EXTENSION.md with Lean Hard Mode documentation.

memory_candidates.content: Lean4 hard-mode contract overrides live in .claude/extensions/lean/context/contracts/ (separate from core .claude/context/contracts/). The anti-analysis.md override sets the H2 formal proof line bar at 30% of tool calls (not core's 20%) to account for lean4 search overhead. The reference-grounding.md override requires a 5-column lemma mapping table (Source, Prop/Location, Lean Identifier, Type Signature, Status) for all Tier 1 tasks.

When creating hard-mode extension agents, make them self-contained with NO @-references to their base agent files. Include all lean-specific sections (blocked tools, allowed tools, search decision tree, zero-debt policy) inline. This prevents accidental base agent override and ensures the hard-mode contracts are the only behavioral layer active.
